stances_toward.note: The 'Moroccan Sahara' is the national cause: Rabat administers the territory it claims and has built its foreign policy on converting that control into recognised sovereignty (Resolution 2797 of 31 Oct 2025 makes the autonomy plan the basis of negotiations; 31 Oct is a national holiday from 2026). The UN has not recognised sovereignty and the resolution still speaks of self-determination, so 'own_territory' is Rabat's reading (controlled and claimed), not a legal finding. The start date 1975 is the standard year and is not sourced in this pass. Bond - kin: the identity claim of the Sahrawis as Moroccans.

relations_to.summary: Morocco claims sovereignty over Western Sahara, which it calls the Moroccan Sahara, and offers autonomy under the Crown as the only settlement (plan of 2007). Resolution 2797 of 31 Oct 2025 makes the plan the basis of negotiations while still speaking of self-determination; MINURSO's mandate runs to 31 Oct 2026.
